title.zh: 共同活动形成并再生产参考修订
title.en: Activity forms and reproduces reference revision

claim.zh: 共享 Process 中，空方法及参考装置经实际失败、取得、安装和使用形成。直接复用 P99 的操作，每一后继位置的失配都修改方法、取得双参考、安装并成功使用；成功兑现的生产回返支付更替和下一修订。统一控制器中存在实际无限 Run，精确衔接形成历史；每轮累计消耗及取得不清零。冻结、断供、储备消耗和旧区分退役保留实际失败与损失。
claim.en: In the shared Process, actual failure, acquisition, installation and use form a reference apparatus from empty retention. Directly reusing P99 operations, mismatch at every successor revises the method and yields newly acquired, installed and successfully used references. Earned production pays succession and the next revision. An actual infinite Run obeys one controller and connects exactly to the formation trace, with cumulative ledgers. Frozen methods, cut return, reserve expenditure and retired distinctions retain failures and losses.

hypotheses.zh: P99 的可寻址二值接触、可靠实际返回、参考绑定、稳定对应、修订律及检查安装操作继续给定。
hypotheses.en: P99’s addressed Boolean contacts, faithful return, bound references, stable correspondence, revision and checked-installation operations remain supplied.

hypotheses.zh: 共同活动按当前承载位置取得下一任务；成功产生一次可兑现且消耗的生产凭据。兑现花费1并取得9单位，保留已安装的后继参考并退役旧接触。
hypotheses.en: The supplied policy addresses the next locus; actual success earns a consumed production claim. Realization spends one and obtains nine units, retains the installed successor reference and retires the old contact.

hypotheses.zh: 计数装置对生产支承开放；接触与承载位置的物理对应、更替和储存能力均为局部条件，不声称封闭有限存量无限持续。
hypotheses.en: The counted installation is open to productive support. Physical contact/succession correspondence, replacement and storage are local premises; a finite closed stock is not claimed to continue forever.

correspondence.zh: 观察、方法、回应、生产与承载是同一关系展开的作用。承载索引伴随实际新地址、失败、参考及使用改变；编号本身不是物质重建证明。时钟只枚举逐步已证符合 choose 的行为，不新增支持或外部选择。
correspondence.en: Observation, method, response, production and carriers are roles in one unfolding. The carrier index accompanies new addressed activity, failure, reference construction and use; a counter alone does not prove material reconstruction. The clock enumerates actions already proved to follow choose, without external support or selection.

detail.zh: execute 直接调用 ReferencePlan.execute；new_available_choice 与 retired_choice 调用原有接触选择定理。
detail.en: execute directly calls ReferencePlan.execute; new_available_choice and retired_choice invoke its contact-selection theorems.

output.zh: 已检查的参考操作、实际回应及选择定义
output.en: Checked reference operations, actual response and selection definitions

input.zh: 连续活动中的 native 操作、方法改变和后继使用
input.en: Native operations, method change and successor use in continuing activity

conditions.zh: 相同内部状态和费用，额外回返、更替及任务律公开
conditions.en: Identical inner state and native costs, with additional return, succession and task laws disclosed

detail.zh: Trace 的实际中间配置拼接与 Run 逐步执行，非改名模型。
detail.en: Trace composition through actual boundary configurations and stepwise Run, not a renamed model.

detail.zh: 新增接触和退役同时说明选择保留条件为何不能由持续性代替。
detail.en: New contact and retirement show why continuing activity cannot substitute for the exact selection-preservation criterion.

detail.zh: cut_return/cut_stops_next 是 P 9 与 P 0 的配对回返干预；reserve_consumed 与 frozen_plan_no_return 是 P 9 内的真实替代执行；retired_choice 证明区分损失。
detail.en: cut_return/cut_stops_next compare the return relation in P 9 and P 0; reserve_consumed and frozen_plan_no_return are genuine alternatives within P 9; retired_choice proves a lost distinction.

limitations.zh: 证明指定开放生产律和任务政策下的形成与持续修订；不保证所有扰动、需求、物理实现或所有旧选择。不是任意装置原语的起源、普遍吸引盆地、整个旧材料模型的编译、规范根据或更强无实质前提目标。
limitations.en: Proves formation and continuing revision under specified open production and task laws, not all disturbances, demands, physical realizations or preservation of every old selection. It does not derive arbitrary sensor primitives, universal basins, a compilation of all older material models, normative warrant or the stronger premise-free programme.

The owned-only commit tree additionally passes core 20261013T131556.258659Z, peripheral 20261013T131750.258973Z, full registry checks and all 49 infrastructure tests, excluding concurrent active work.

next_delta.zh: 本会话的形成—分化—方法及候选修订—使用—受支持接续的理论整合已完成。具体应用另须对应证据；对公开前提或交接的新反例会重开受影响结论。
next_delta.en: The requested formation–differentiation–method/candidate revision–use–supported continuation integration is complete. Applications need their own correspondence evidence; new counterexamples to premises or handoffs would reopen the affected claim.

history.zh: P103 延续原研究并直接复用 P93/P99；不把重复回执或理论综述计为另一独立机制。
history.en: P103 continues the original study with direct reuse of P93/P99; repeated receipts or the theoretical synthesis are not counted as another independent mechanism.

history.en: Review of this main commit’s isolated content: only this session’s P93/P99/P103 chapter notes and module rows are added; earlier bytes, proofs and claims remain. Fingerprints bind this exact commit scope.
